title: MIB generator OID assignments
description: The number and the name of every field the MIB has ever held. This file holds the stability promise: a live OID never moves, and a retired number is never reused.

version.description: The format version. The loader stops when it reads a version it does not know.

base_oid.description: The MIB root. It must equal DEFAULT_BASE_OID in src/metrics_gateway/snmp.py. The run stops when the two differ.

entries.description: One entry for each field, live or obsolete. Sorted by subtree and then by column, so a run writes stable bytes.

key.description: The stable identity, in the form <scope>/<source path>. It is never the descriptor, because a rename of a name must not move an OID.

subtree.description: The number below the base OID. It must be a value of SUBTREE_BY_SCOPE, and it must match the scope in the key.

column.description: The column below the subtree. 1 to 89 is a data column. 90 to 98 is reserved for the gateway health readings the catalog owns. 99 is the row identity column and never appears here.

descriptor.description: The SMIv2 name. It starts with a lowercase letter, it holds letters and digits only, and it stays at or below 64 characters. It is stored, so it never changes after the first run.

state.description: live when the field is in the current MIB. obsolete when Mist removed the field. An obsolete entry keeps its number reserved and its object carries STATUS obsolete.

notes.description: Free text for a person. Record here why a field went obsolete, and in which Mist release.
